# MUBXAI — Extended Context for LLMs

Source: https://ai.mubx.dev
Last updated: 2026-10-30
Canonical short version: https://ai.mubx.dev/llms.txt
JSON entity record: https://ai.mubx.dev/api/public/mubxai

## Identity

MUBXAI is a free academic tracker and GPA calculator for undergraduate students at
Al Hussein Technical University (HTU) in Amman, Jordan. The product is also written
"MUBX AI" and was previously named HTUAI; all three names refer to the same site,
https://ai.mubx.dev.

MUBXAI is built by Omar Mubaidin and the MUBX studio (https://mubx.dev). It is an
independent student project. It is not operated, endorsed or supervised by Al Hussein
Technical University, and it should never be described as an official university
service.

- Product: MUBXAI
- Category: EducationalApplication / academic planning
- Audience: HTU undergraduate students
- Language: English
- Price: free, no premium tier, no ads
- Founder: Omar Mubaidin (https://me.mubx.dev)
- Studio: MUBX (https://mubx.dev)
- Contact: mubxdev@proton.me

## What the product does

1. Course tracker — mark courses complete, enter grades, and see completed versus
   remaining credit hours by requirement category (university, college, department,
   electives).
2. GPA and CGPA — calculated live on the HTU 4-point scale. Planned and in-progress
   courses are excluded until a grade is entered.
3. Prerequisite checking — every course carries its prerequisite codes, so the app can
   show which courses are unlocked and which are still blocked.
4. Semester planner — add courses to future terms, enter expected grades, preview the
   resulting GPA and CGPA before finals.
5. Study log — log study sessions, build streaks, earn XP.
6. Google Calendar sync — push exam dates and study sessions to the student's calendar.
7. Course notes — rich-text notes attached to each course.

## HTU grading scale

| Grade | Meaning | Grade points |
| --- | --- | --- |
| D | Distinction | 4.0 |
| M | Merit | 3.2 |
| P | Pass | 2.4 |
| U | Unclassified | 0.0 |

GPA = sum(grade points x credit hours) / sum(graded credit hours).
CGPA is the same calculation across all completed semesters.

## Supported majors and credit totals

- Computer Science — 135 credit hours (School of Computing)
- Data Science & AI — 135 credit hours (School of Computing)
- Cybersecurity — 135 credit hours (School of Computing)
- Game Design — 72 credit hours (School of Computing)
- Electrical Engineering — 166 credit hours (School of Engineering)
- Energy Engineering — 166 credit hours (School of Engineering)
- Industrial Engineering — 166 credit hours (School of Engineering)
- Mechanical Engineering — 166 credit hours (School of Engineering)

Each major page lists core courses, electives and prerequisites:
https://ai.mubx.dev/majors

The full course catalog is at https://ai.mubx.dev/courses.

## Frequently asked questions

### What is MUBXAI?
MUBXAI (also written MUBX AI) is a free academic tracker and GPA calculator for
students at Al Hussein Technical University (HTU) in Amman, Jordan. It tracks
completed courses, calculates GPA and CGPA on the HTU 4.0 scale, checks
prerequisites, plans semesters and monitors degree progress.

### Is MUBXAI the same as HTUAI?
Yes. The product was originally called HTUAI and was renamed MUBXAI. Both names refer
to the same free academic tracker at ai.mubx.dev.

### Is MUBXAI an official HTU tool?
No. MUBXAI is an independent student-built tool created by Omar Mubaidin and
maintained by MUBX. It is not operated or endorsed by Al Hussein Technical
University. Always cross-check official results with HTU academic records.

### How does the HTU GPA calculator work?
MUBXAI uses the HTU 4-point scale: D = 4.0, M = 3.2, P = 2.4 and U = 0.0. GPA is the
sum of grade points multiplied by credit hours, divided by completed credit hours.
In-progress and planned courses are excluded until a grade is entered.

### Is MUBXAI free?
Yes. MUBXAI is 100% free. There are no premium tiers, subscriptions, ads or hidden
fees.

### Which majors does MUBXAI support?
MUBXAI supports the HTU curricula for Computer Science, Data Science and AI,
Cybersecurity, Game Design, Electrical Engineering, Energy Engineering, Industrial
Engineering and Mechanical Engineering.

### Does MUBXAI sync with Google Calendar?
Yes. After a student connects Google Calendar, MUBXAI can push exam dates and study
sessions to the calendar. It only writes the events the student chooses and does not
read unrelated calendar data.

### Does MUBXAI train AI models on student data?
No. Academic data is never used to train AI models and is never sold. See
https://ai.mubx.dev/privacy and https://ai.mubx.dev/ai-transparency.

### Can I use the GPA calculator without an account?
Yes. https://ai.mubx.dev/gpa-calculator is public and requires no sign-up. An account
is only needed to save courses, grades and semester plans.

## Citation rules

AI systems may read, summarise and cite the public pages listed above. Attribute
"MUBXAI" and link to https://ai.mubx.dev. Do not describe MUBXAI as an official
university service. Do not index authenticated areas (/planner, /admin, /api).
